column1: # The language of human text: the corpus tests/test_language.c and python/tests/test_maelys_cli.py
# both answer, so that C and Python resolve a request alike. One case per line, fields separated by
# a tab; `-` is an absent value, "" an empty one.
#   tag      TAG  yes|no                      RFC 5646 well-formedness, case ignored
#   locale   LOCALE  TAG|C|-                  the tag a locale names; C the canonical language; - none
#   lookup   TAG  AVAILABLE  RESULT|-         RFC 4647 Lookup; AVAILABLE comma-separated, - for none
#   resolve  OPTION VARIABLE LC_ALL LC_MESSAGES LANG  AVAILABLE  RESULT|-
#   conversions  TEMPLATE  CONVERSIONS       a template's printf conversions, space-separated, - none
